title: 飞盾战神

sync.scope: Source statistics tables and available 2026 history; base values

facts: The Royal Champion is the fifth Hero unlocked once the Hero Hall reaches Level 7, which is available at Town Hall level 13. She has moderately high damage per second, moderate health, and targets defenses. She can also jump over Walls, much like the Hog Rider and Headhunter.
Upgrading the Blacksmith to level 7 and 8 unlocks the Hog Rider Puppet and Haste Vial respectively.
